scope: All 40 currently open GitHub issues and their available comments; current implementation references, public reserved entrypoints and conditional instruction/OS gates.

discovered_implementation_gap.old: Reserved pointer-to-pointer Ozaki decomposition had no defined component storage/ownership and always returned unsupported.
discovered_implementation_gap.resolution: Delete the old declaration/definition and replace with explicit exact integer radix128 query/split/merge, caller-owned spans and strict C17 installed consumer.

test_status: Applicable full configured local CPU-ASan/HIP suites and fresh installed native/DLPack/C17 consumers pass; unavailable targets and explicit stopped lanes retain their recorded boundaries.
interpretation: Source completion covers the concrete implemented issue envelopes. Hardware availability, supported numerical/instruction contracts, native OS/link qualification, physical fault/counter evidence and measured payoff remain separate. This is not an all-issues-closed or default-route promotion assertion.

issues.title: [P1] Invalidate or roll back bounded outputs after partial GEMM failure; mixed CRT planes currently export successfully
qualification_or_outcome_gates: Real device-failure qualification remains; local transaction/cleanup regressions pass.

issues.title: [P2] Compute exact-wide admission once and make expensive moment refinement demand-driven
qualification_or_outcome_gates: The explicit scalar-first public control is implemented. Five independent shared-host processes per cohort show range-separated gains over default eager-axis calls at 128 and 256, while compiled recipes do not beat scalar-first in the larger medians. Proof-cache/refinement phase attribution and broader gfx942 qualification remain.

issues.title: [Research P1] Add a conversion-aware analytical planner before measured kernel promotion
qualification_or_outcome_gates: Applicable SDK10.1 local Release, HIP Debug, HIP OpenMP-OFF and CPU ASan checks pass. Bounded independent stage/whole-route cohorts are recorded separately before and after restart. Broader held-out shapes/providers, selection regret, physical resource peaks and clocks/counters remain; no default routing or cache promotion.

issues.title: [Research P1] Calibrate exact-GEMM roofs with instruction, conversion and memory microbenchmarks
qualification_or_outcome_gates: Bounded gfx1100 instruction, system/LDS/memory, CRT, resident and product-stage measurements are recorded at source72c55c2 with separate original/post-restart cohorts and fixed held-out interval gates. Complete conversion/prefix/signedness/cache/ablation curves, physical clocks/resources/counters, unseen-workload prediction and broader targets remain. Historical failed models are preserved.

issues.title: [Research P2] Extend offline modulus search into a certified hardware-weighted scheme optimizer
qualification_or_outcome_gates: Independent complete-pipeline custom-basis/form calibration, broader provider/target execution and profitable complete-cost selection remain unqualified. Library/distributed computation and opt-in automatic selection are implemented.

issues.title: [Research P1] Build cost-aware device bound discovery and compact adaptive-prefix schedules
qualification_or_outcome_gates: Summary reuse passes local CPU-ASan/gfx1100 and installed static/shared checks. Forty matched host-output captures have 1.5-8.7% better medians, but none meets both fixed independent-process spread/range-separation gates. Qualify benefit against the best same-contract fixed/global controls and bounded full-width fallback overhead.
Planner-selected proof policy and held-out measured routing remain separate gates.

issues.title: [Research P1] Fuse native conversion and multiple residue channels inside matrix-engine tiles
qualification_or_outcome_gates: Launched-instruction/resource evidence and matched fused conversion/matrix-engine complete-route measurements remain.

issues.title: [Research P2] Schedule residue and output tiles for measured XCD/cache locality
qualification_or_outcome_gates: Target-specific cache/XCD placement, counters and independent complete-route profitability remain unqualified.

issues.title: [Research P2] Add exact split-K/Stream-K with hierarchical modular partial reduction
qualification_or_outcome_gates: Same-contract split-K/Stream-K profitability and profiler evidence remain; broader provider composition remains with its owning issues.

issues.title: [Research P2] Build heterogeneous grouped matrix-engine work queues with bounded persistent scheduling
qualification_or_outcome_gates: Completion fairness/resource evidence and independent complete-route persistent-queue qualification remain; optional adaptive/split/locality composition is not presumed.

issues.title: [Research P1] Compare overflow-proven direct CRT and balanced merge trees against current Garner
qualification_or_outcome_gates: Applicable prepared CRT/export correctness passes in the SDK10.1 local configuration matrix. Bounded raw CRT, checked host-export, retained complete-GEMM and cold complete-GEMM comparisons retain separate contracts, variance and negative results. Five-policy/full-prefix crossover, fused/distributed consumers, hardware traffic and broader targets remain.

issues.title: [Research P2] Co-design residue layouts for packing, matrix tiles and CRT export
qualification_or_outcome_gates: Compiled fragment/instruction/resource evidence and matched full-route layout/reuse measurements remain; no default layout policy is promoted.

issues.title: [Research P1] Implement value-preserving device exact-wide base extension
qualification_or_outcome_gates: Independent exact-lift/converted-basis stage and whole-chain measurements, amortization and broader target qualification remain.

issues.title: [Research P2] Compile resident exact-arithmetic DAGs with precision and lifetime planning
qualification_or_outcome_gates: Native/uniform/ragged/packed materialization selection, real shared-B/lift/arena execution, chain DP and bounded DAG search are implemented. Independent stage prices and same-graph process-held-out observations are recorded with fixed tolerance. Observed long setup/training amortization, unseen graphs/datasets/providers, physical peak/capacity and qualified routing remain. Bounded search is not globally optimal; unsupported families remain ineligible.

issues.title: [Research P1] Complete public asynchronous execution and graph-safe lifetime contracts
qualification_or_outcome_gates: Native Linux/CDNA adapter and caller-graph execution, real device-fault/failed-drain recovery, physical overlap/traffic and complete-route payoff remain unqualified. Multi-body caller capture, finite/wrap pipelines and distinct-slot in-flight pools are implemented.

issues.title: [Research P3] Prototype certified FP4/FP6/FP8 modular GEMM with fixed-scale exactness gates
qualification_or_outcome_gates: Actual gfx942/gfx1201 FP8 and gfx950 fixed/dynamic/mixed FP4/FP6/FP8 lane, scale-ordering, internal-accumulator and adversarial exactness qualification remains. Strongest complete INT8 controls, resource/counter evidence and profitable routing remain unmeasured.

issues.title: [Research P3] Qualify packed INT4/IU4 kernels for narrow exact semantic subsets
qualification_or_outcome_gates: Actual INT4 opcode/fragment/resource evidence and independent complete-route profitability remain; no automatic route promotion.

issues.title: [Research P2] Add exact algebraic epilogue composition without intermediate residue round trips
qualification_or_outcome_gates: Compiled epilogue resource evidence and matched fused/unfused complete-route measurements remain; no speedup or promotion is inferred from correctness.

issues.title: [Research P3] Evaluate certified one-level Strassen and rank-23 modular block GEMM
qualification_or_outcome_gates: Strongest-control large-shape bilinear performance, physical ISA/resources and the original speed/memory promotion gates remain. Canonical 204-operation rank48 SLP execution and independent expansion proof are implemented.

issues.title: [Research P3] Add opt-in Freivalds and redundant-residue checks with explicit guarantees
qualification_or_outcome_gates: Applicable local registered integrity and publication fixtures pass in the SDK10.1 Release suite. Actual multi-device fault coverage and complete-route integrity overhead remain unqualified.

issues.title: [Research P2] Implement true modulus-sharded multi-GPU GEMM with residue-consistency epochs
qualification_or_outcome_gates: Actual linked MPI/RCCL/rocSHMEM multi-GPU/multinode execution, device memory ordering, rank/device-fault cleanup, topology/NUMA/traffic and scaling remain unqualified. Local CPU/mock and single-device gfx1100 coverage does not qualify network or peer transport.

issues.title: [Research P3] Qualify explicit Sparse-A and proof-preserving hybrid block-sparse execution
qualification_or_outcome_gates: Actual structured-sparse target instruction qualification, independent sustained crossover and the >=1.5x gate remain; gfx1100 unsupported cases stay skipped.

issues.title: [Research P3] Prototype CDNA5 TDM and cluster multicast for shared RNS source tiles
qualification_or_outcome_gates: Core SDK10.1 AMD Clang24 lacks __builtin_amdgcn_s_wait_dscnt, so the guarded TDM path remains unavailable. Qualify a supporting compiler/runtime/device, real transfer/cluster/fragment differentials, wait/barrier stress, emitted instructions, traffic/stalls/occupancy/spills and matched end-to-end costs.

issues.title: [Research P2] Add proof-selected native narrow-integer paths for tiny and skinny GEMM
qualification_or_outcome_gates: Bounded native-vector/public-backend and resident narrow-input comparisons are recorded with exact checks and fixed variance gates. Launched instruction/resource evidence, broader tiny/skinny shapes and profitable complete-route selection remain.

issues.title: [Research P3] Add optional CPU matrix-instruction backends while preserving the independent scalar oracle
qualification_or_outcome_gates: AMX and optional AArch64 I8MM source/OS admission/packing owners are implemented. Actual supported CPU/OS runtime, independent target differentials, end-to-end performance/energy and cohort adoption remain unqualified.

issues.title: [Research P2] Generate and prune certified kernel variants with inspectable manifests
qualification_or_outcome_gates: Logical/mutation regression passes in the SDK10.1 Release suite. Actual compiled lane/resource equivalence, measured pruning and promotion remain target-specific gates.

issues.title: [Roadmap] Execute the research-derived exact-GEMM architecture backlog
qualification_or_outcome_gates: Umbrella acceptance depends on the remaining child measurement, failure, configuration and hardware gates, plus explicitly unsupported provider/conditional extensions; a local Release pass does not complete the whole roadmap.

issues.title: Autodetect GPU toolchains, vcpkg and dependencies in Windows/Linux presets
qualification_or_outcome_gates: Automatic Windows Python/SDK/GPU-family/compiler/VS/tool/package selection and loaded-runtime binding pass locally. Actual Linux discovery/setup and applicable GPU preset qualification remain.

issues.title: Prepare reproducible Linux GPU sessions with preflight, locked setup and bounded run plans
qualification_or_outcome_gates: Actual bounded Linux GPU session/preflight/lock/resume rehearsal remains unavailable; local runner contract fixtures pass.

issues.title: [Research P2] Add exact complex 3M GEMM as a residue-resident paired-value composition
qualification_or_outcome_gates: Failure/ownership qualification and independent matched complete-route paired-complex measurements remain; historical timings describe older storage.

issues.title: [Build] Upgrade LLVM/Clang and all dependencies through compatibility-gated locks
qualification_or_outcome_gates: SDK10.1 local Windows Release and the follow-up HIP Debug, HIP OpenMP-OFF, CPU LLVM23.1.4 ASan /MD RelWithDebInfo and static/shared installed-consumer checks pass. The initial /MDd Debug-CRT ASan build is unsupported and preserved. Within-new-stack approach comparisons do not establish matched prior/new-stack regression. Linux, broader compiler/ABI/runner compatibility and selected Git upgrade remain; installed Git2.52.0.windows.1 differs from selected2.56.0.windows.3.

issues.title: [Docs] Deslopify the README and consolidate all project documentation
qualification_or_outcome_gates: Current local documentation inventory/path/anchor/command checks pass. Windows initializer and archive/case materialization commands have been exercised; remaining platform-specific command rehearsals, especially Linux, stay unqualified.

issues.title: [Research P2] Add symmetry-aware exact Gram/SYRK execution with triangular ownership and single-source packing
qualification_or_outcome_gates: Applicable CPU/Boost and gfx1100 direct/matrix five-product Gram fixtures pass. Physical fragment/ISA/resource evidence, broader targets and strongest-control cold/steady/refresh/export profitability remain open.

issues.title: [Research P2] Recode wrap64 into signed radix-256 digits for correction-free matrix-engine convolution
qualification_or_outcome_gates: Real CDNA4 MFMA mapping/ISA/resource execution and independent sustained signed-radix qualification require appropriate hardware; no profitable cohort is claimed.

issues.title: [Perf P2] Make resident storage demand-driven and eliminate duplicate native upload materializations
qualification_or_outcome_gates: Live/peak requested device and pinned-host observations pass CPU/GPU and installed strict C17 ABI checks, including pending-free retention, resets and owner moves. Matched storage/latency before/after, physical-capacity fixtures and broader-platform qualification remain.

issues.title: [Research P3] Prototype word-size modular GEMM with certified asymmetric multiword lowering
qualification_or_outcome_gates: Real MFMA target mapping/ISA execution and independent asymmetric/concatenated word-modular cohorts remain; unsupported instructions are explicit skips.

issues.title: [Architecture P2] Add public HIP-native buffer import and export with explicit ownership and stream interoperability
qualification_or_outcome_gates: Optional DLPack unit and four installed HIP producer/consumer checks pass, including synchronous and graph-backed DLPack paths. Native Linux GPU coverage, real failed-drain recovery and matched DLPack performance remain unqualified. Historical native-interface speedups retain their original source identity.

issues.title: [Research P2] Execute exact GEMM beyond device memory with budgeted single-GPU panel streaming
qualification_or_outcome_gates: Real >32 GiB capacity and observed requested allocation reconciliation pass on the 24 GiB gfx1100 card. Achieved overlap traces, independent steady crossover and held-out panel calibration remain separate.

issues.title: [Research P2] Accelerate RNS conversion and CRT with fixed-matrix transforms and packed dot products
qualification_or_outcome_gates: Applicable transform/conversion and prepared-policy correctness passes in the SDK10.1 local configuration matrix. Bounded raw CRT, checked host-export and complete-GEMM comparisons preserve their contracts and variance. Full-prefix crossover, physical traffic and profitable production selection remain; no default promotion.

issues.title: [Perf P2] Preserve packed-dot residue GEMM across all modulus planes and grouped/scheduled paths
qualification_or_outcome_gates: Local scalar and packed-dot differentials pass. Selected ISA/resource/launch evidence and independent same-scheduler arithmetic comparisons remain; no target-specific promotion.
